description: Murf AI is a voice AI company headquartered in San Francisco that began in October 2020. It sells the Falcon text-to-speech API for voice agents alongside its Murf Studio voiceover and dubbing products, and lists Finch, a streaming speech-to-text API. Falcon can be called through regional endpoints in the US, EU, UK, India, Japan, South Korea and other countries, or deployed on-premise.
name: Murf AI
